title: ayenia divaricata var. guaranitica
intro: Ayenia divaricata var. guaranitica, commonly known as "Cayaponia," is a perennial plant species belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and fever, due to its numerous health benefits, such as reducing oxidative stress and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The therapeutic actions of Ayenia divaricata var. guaranitica include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its traditional use in treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
